searchText: I don't even remember if there are code paths that touch exited validators - the spec is certainly not written with this in mind .. one of those formal verification efforts could finally be useful to prove that they're truly frozen 😉 that said, we already cache them so if they don't change, the cache will deal with it - our problem is more that we store state snapshots which take time to memcpy/compress and we don't yet filter out these dead ones i was looking at that the other day, we'll need to look at epoch transition speed some time soonish For this release, there [was a typo](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4524) in one of the new config variable names. Sorry about this, it will be fixed in the next release. Thanks to <@680234424037670912> for noticing/fixing this.
